parsed.post: Discarding 0.993640; it regressed from my best 0.992925. It seems 0.03 LR might be slightly unstable or just noisy for this seed/shard setup. I'm reverting to 0.03 LR (best) and will now test WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if it stabilizes the lower learning rate and recovers the performance.
parsed.description: Reverting to best LR=0.03 and testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if a gradual warmup improves stability and convergence at this lower learning rate.
